eps.o: The deep, dark woods may be home to our heroes — but that doesn't mean it's safe. After a series of close calls, it's time for them to escape.
In the run-down cabin, things are looking up for our mother mouse, raccoon and bullfrog. Until the rainstorm brings something terrible to their door...
The cabin may still be standing, but is it secure from ominous outsiders? Our heroes must now return to the woods where they belong — if they can.
